body:
## Scope

Umbrella tracker for rebuilding the talent marketplace fresh on current `main` (NOT patching #183). Good IP is ported file-by-file from old branch `714a69af`. Decisions are operator-locked in **ADR-0002** (`docs/architecture/adr-0002-talent-marketplace-rebuild.md`, PR #423).

Headline decisions:
- Rebuild-not-patch; #183 closed.
- Two-sided PUBLIC job board (SEO listings, browse w/o account, applicant profile at Apply, auto-flip to sub-coach). Full web parity (Next.js/SSR) + mobile.
- Connect: reuse existing `/coach/connect/*` (one surface; drop `CoachConnectAccount` + `/talent/connect/*`; thin adapter TM-10, append-only).
- Migration re-date floor: after `20261219000000`.
- Background check + anti-bot: built IN-HOUSE (no Checkr / Stripe Identity / Turnstile).
- RLS spine idiom; operator sign-off gate on PII/RLS/auth-surface PRs.

Open items (operator decides later): web SSR lane (shared vs standalone); gym-owner hirer identity model; Chain B `ContractEnvelope` wire-now vs seam.

## Chain plan

Full sequenced build chain: `plans/TM_REBUILD_CHAIN_V2.md` (in the `tgp-agent-context` repo).

Closes #183.
title: [TM] Rebuild talent marketplace on current main (two-sided job board; reuse /coach/connect/*; in-house verify+anti-bot) — closes #183
